sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Order

The present revision petition under Sections 397/401 of the Cr.P.C. challenges the order dated 16.01.2019 in FIR No. 271/2018 under Sections 354/376/509/34 of the IPC and Sections 4/8/12 of the POCSO Act, registered at P.S. Swaroop Nagar, passed by Ms. Seema Maini, ASJ- 01/Special Judge, POCSO Act (North) Rohini, whereby the petitioner was charged for offences under Sections 354/376/509/506(11)/34 of the IPC and Sections 4/8/12 of the POCSO Act.
2.

Learned APP for the State, on instructions from Investigating Officer, submits that in the present case, the petitioner has since been acquitted vide order dated 01.08.2022, passed by Ms. Richa Gusain Solanki, ASJ (FSTC), POCSO, Rohini Court.
3. None appears on behalf of the petitioner.
4. In view thereof, the present petition is dismissed in default for non- prosecution and disposed of accordingly.
5. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
